subsystems.name: Body in White
subsystems.blurb: The welded shell. Everything else hangs off it, so every change here is somebody else's change too.

subsystems.name: Battery Pack
subsystems.blurb: Cells, busbars and a cooling plate. Heavy, expensive, and the reason for half the crash load cases.

subsystems.name: Drive Unit
subsystems.blurb: Motor, inverter and reduction gearbox. Quiet until it is not.

subsystems.name: Chassis
subsystems.blurb: Suspension, steering and brakes. Where the ride reviews are won and lost.

subsystems.name: Thermal & HVAC
subsystems.blurb: One loop keeps the cabin comfortable and the pack alive. It cannot always do both.

subsystems.name: Vehicle Electronics
subsystems.blurb: Harness, controllers and the bus they argue over.

subsystems.name: Interior
subsystems.blurb: Seats, trim and the display everyone judges the car by.

subsystems.name: Airframe
subsystems.blurb: Wing, fuselage and empennage. Fatigue life is written here and nowhere else.

subsystems.name: Propulsion
subsystems.blurb: Engine, generator and propeller. It carries the weight penalty for everybody.

subsystems.name: Avionics
subsystems.blurb: Displays, radios and navigation. Certification reads this box very slowly.

subsystems.name: Flight Controls
subsystems.blurb: Surfaces, linkages and trim. Feel is a requirement even when nobody writes it down.

subsystems.name: Landing Gear
subsystems.blurb: Struts, wheels and brakes. Two seconds of work, every flight, at full load.

subsystems.name: Cabin
subsystems.blurb: Seats, restraints and egress. The part the pilot actually touches.

subsystems.name: Mount & Cradle
subsystems.blurb: The structure that takes recoil into the vehicle without taking the roof with it.

subsystems.name: Traverse Drives
subsystems.blurb: Azimuth and elevation servos. Slew rate and backlash decide whether it can track.

subsystems.name: Sighting System
subsystems.blurb: Day and thermal channels with a laser rangefinder. Boresight drifts if you let it.

subsystems.name: Ammunition Feed
subsystems.blurb: Chute, links and the stoppage clearance nobody wants to demonstrate.

subsystems.name: Fire Control
subsystems.blurb: Ballistic solution, stabilisation and the interlocks that keep it legal.

subsystems.name: Power & Signal
subsystems.blurb: Slip ring, harness and the vehicle bus it has to share.

name: Spacecraft
hint: a small satellite bus for low Earth orbit

subsystems.name: Bus Structure
subsystems.blurb: Panels and the primary load path. It has one launch to survive and years to sit still.

subsystems.name: Power
subsystems.blurb: Arrays, battery and regulation. Everything downstream is a negotiation over watts.

subsystems.name: Thermal
subsystems.blurb: Radiators, heaters and coatings. Nothing convects up there, so it all has to radiate.

subsystems.name: Communications
subsystems.blurb: Transponder and antennas. If this is down, nothing else can tell you it is down.

subsystems.name: Attitude Control
subsystems.blurb: Wheels, magnetorquers and star tracker. Pointing budget lives here.

subsystems.name: Payload
subsystems.blurb: The instrument the whole bus exists to carry, and the only part the customer names.

subsystems.name: Onboard Computer
subsystems.blurb: Flight software, watchdog and the safe mode you hope never runs.

subsystems.name: Manipulator Arm
subsystems.blurb: Seven joints and the remote centre they have to hold while the patient breathes.

subsystems.name: Instrument Interface
subsystems.blurb: Sterile adapter, cable drives and tool changeover between cases.

subsystems.name: Surgeon Console
subsystems.blurb: Grips, pedals and stereo view. Latency here is felt, not measured.

subsystems.name: Vision System
subsystems.blurb: Endoscope, illumination and image chain. The only eyes in the abdomen.

subsystems.name: Safety Chain
subsystems.blurb: Force limits, watchdogs and the hardware stop that outranks the software.

subsystems.name: Sterile Barrier
subsystems.blurb: Drapes and seals. It has to hold through a four-hour case and an autoclave cycle.

subsystems.name: Arm Structure
subsystems.blurb: Castings and the reach-versus-stiffness argument that set the whole envelope.

subsystems.name: Joint Drives
subsystems.blurb: Servo motors, gearboxes and brakes. Backlash shows up as repeatability.

subsystems.name: End Effector
subsystems.blurb: Gripper and tool plate. The only part that touches the product.

subsystems.name: Controller
subsystems.blurb: Motion planning, kinematics and the teach pendant people actually use.

subsystems.name: Sensing
subsystems.blurb: Encoders, force sensing and whatever vision the cell needs to find the part.

subsystems.name: Cell Integration
subsystems.blurb: Fencing, conveyors and PLC handshakes. The arm is never the whole job.

subsystems.name: Pressure Hull
subsystems.blurb: The sphere and its penetrators. One crew, one boundary, no second chance.

subsystems.name: Ballast & Trim
subsystems.blurb: Tanks, pumps and droppable weight. It decides whether you come back up.

subsystems.name: Propulsion
subsystems.blurb: Thrusters and their controllers, working against a current nobody modelled.

subsystems.name: Life Support
subsystems.blurb: Scrubbers, oxygen and the dive duration everything else is sized against.

subsystems.name: Power
subsystems.blurb: Battery pods and distribution, sealed against seawater for the whole dive.

subsystems.name: Science Payload
subsystems.blurb: Manipulator, sampling gear and lights. The reason the dive was funded.

name: Wind Turbine
hint: an offshore direct-drive wind turbine nacelle

subsystems.name: Rotor & Blades
subsystems.blurb: Three blades and a hub, turning twenty years of fatigue cycles into revenue.

subsystems.name: Direct-Drive Generator
subsystems.blurb: A very large, very slow machine with an air gap that must not close.

subsystems.name: Power Converter
subsystems.blurb: Back-to-back converter and transformer, and the grid code they have to satisfy.

subsystems.name: Pitch & Yaw
subsystems.blurb: Blade pitch and nacelle yaw. Both are also the brakes when the wind is wrong.

subsystems.name: Nacelle & Bedplate
subsystems.blurb: The frame and cover taking every load into the tower, in salt air.

subsystems.name: Turbine Control
subsystems.blurb: Supervisory control, condition monitoring and the alarms an operator sees onshore.
